paras: Dalophia luluae is an endangered species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is endemic to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The specific name, luluae, refers to the Lulu River of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The preferred natural habitat of Dalophia luluae is savanna, at altitudes of 800–1,000 m (2,600–3,300 ft).
Dalophia luluae is terrestrial and fossorial.
